goal: Give node operators and external mining clients visibility into memory pinned by active block templates
Solves unmonitored memory growth when IPC clients hold evicted mempool transactions indefinitely
reviewability: Ready to review, but check whether the red CI run is related before doing a deep review
agreement: Strong support with extensive review and testing, no open objections (ryanofsky, enochaz, xyzconstant)
Verified in production with Stratum v2 template provider on mainnet for ~20 hours (xyzconstant)
Concept approval and verified locking, lifetime handling, and shutdown cleanup (ryanofsky, enochaz)
Unanswered question on whether the interface needs a struct or can return a primitive (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P3 because it exposes template memory load tracking over IPC to external template providers
ensures asynchronous template cleanup finishes safely if a client disconnects during node shutdown

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because external mining clients can hold block templates and pin evicted transactions indefinitely
provides memory usage visibility actively needed by downstream Stratum v2 template providers
